theorems.name: Submission.sff_tangentProjection_local_extension
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)) (V : Set (Rn n)) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation 2 M V W ψ → (∀ x ∈ V, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x).toLinearMap) → ∀ x₀ ∈ V, ∃ Q : Rn N → (Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N), DifferentiableAt ℝ Q (ψ x₀) ∧ tangentProjection M =ᶠ[𝓝[M] ψ x₀] Q ∧ ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 x₀, Q (ψ x) = (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x).toLinearMap).starProjection
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
